title: AlloyDB: Observability Field Deprecated
summary: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` field within the `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema has been marked as deprecated. Developers should plan to migrate away from its use.
details: The `trackActiveQueryPlan` property in the `ObservabilityInstanceConfig` schema is now explicitly marked as deprecated. This signals that the field will be removed in a future release. While still functional for now, developers should review their AlloyDB instance observability configurations and prepare to transition away from using this field to avoid future breaking changes.
